caption_verbatim: Fig. 1. Architecture of the proposed scheme.
plots: Schematic block diagram (not a data plot). Legend: h_text = textual input embeddings, h_time = time-series input embeddings, h_forecast = forecasting embeddings; snowflake = Frozen, flame = Trainable. Panels: Textual input embedder (Tokenizer, Text-embedding LLM); Time-series input embedder (Instance norm + Patching, Linear embedder); Forecasting LLM (x K transformer blocks: PE, Multi-Head Attention with LoRA on Wq/Wv/Wk/Wo, Feed Forward, Add & Norm); Output projection.
notes: Caption confirmed in the PDF text layer (PAGE 4) and on page_04.png. Regeneration needs a redraw, not data.
